test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A chair is marked for Rs. 210 and sold for Rs. 189. Find the discount rate for this transaction.
solution:
Given:

Marked price = (M.P) = Rs. 210

Selling price = (S.P) = Rs. 189

Formula used:

If marked price is M.P, selling price is S.P and discount is D, then

Discount = M.P - S.P

Rate of discount = (100/M.P) × Discount

Calculation:

Discount = 210 - 189 = Rs. 21

So, Rate of discount = (21/210) × 100 = 10 %

∴ The rate of discount is 10 %
